items.text: Explain what IaC is and why it replaces manual console management
Distinguish between declarative and imperative IaC approaches with examples
Name the five core problems that IaC solves (consistency, DR, cross-env, tracking, reusability)
Explain the difference between cloud-specific tools (CloudFormation) and multi-cloud tools (Terraform)
Describe Ansible's push-based, agentless architecture and how it differs from Chef/Puppet
Explain the relationship between CloudFormation Templates and Stacks
Identify all five AWS Systems Manager sub-services and their purposes
Write a basic CloudFormation template with Resources, Parameters, and Outputs sections
Create a CloudFormation stack using the Infrastructure Composer and deploy it
Create an IAM role with AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore and attach it to an EC2 instance
Connect to an EC2 instance without SSH keys using Session Manager
Execute a shell command on multiple EC2 instances simultaneously using Run Command
Store a secret in Parameter Store as a SecureString and retrieve it programmatically
State that the Resources section is the ONLY mandatory section in a CloudFormation template
Recall that CloudFormation uses YAML or JSON; Terraform uses HCL; Pulumi uses Python/TypeScript
Explain that SSM Agent is pre-installed on Amazon Linux 2, Amazon Linux 2023, and AWS Windows AMIs
State that AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore is the minimum IAM policy for SSM management
Describe Session Manager's three key advantages: no SSH keys, no open ports, no bastion host
Explain that Parameter Store SecureString is encrypted with AWS KMS
